findings.shape: Five septate frustules meet at corner attachment cues in a selected zigzag colony. Valves have a broad middle and capitate ends; girdle walls and internal septa remain visible.
findings.surface: Prepared-frustule presentation distinguishes centrally inflated capitate valves from rectangular septate girdle walls. Closed girdle-band and septum cues have original numeric surfaces without living plastid claims.
findings.movement: A mild external colony drift changes only the whole group. No self-propelled swimming, cell division, mucilage mechanics or life-cycle simulation.
evidenceScope: Selected diagnosis and ecology: medial inflation wider than ends, closed girdle bands/septa, rectangular girdle view, zigzag/stellate colonies and nonmotility. Strain and colony variation are not separate species records.

corrections: Replaced the mixed-species source plate with documented crops of only its two panel-g regions, retaining labels and scale bars.

findings.residual: Girdle-band count, rudimentary septa, rimoportulae and marginal spines are incomplete; corner geometry and valve ends remain idealized. Some close surfaces intersect or occlude internal bands. The source shows isolated cleaned frustules, not this measured colony or living optical appearance. Only whole-group external drift is illustrated.
